name: 82240 · Torrington, WY
findings: ZIP 82240 (Torrington) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 82240 (Torrington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 82240 (Torrington) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
